text: ProMinent GmbH of Heidelberg was founded in 1960 by Prof. Dr. h. c. Viktor Dulger as Chemie & Filter GmbH; in 2001 the founder's two sons took over the management of the company as managing partners (geschäftsführende Gesellschafter), and the managing directors listed today are Prof. Dr. Andreas Dulger (CEO) and Dr.-Ing. Rainer Dulger alongside Dr. Michael Benedikt Nagel.
short: ProMinent is the Dulger family's Heidelberg company, led by the founder's sons

source.name: ProMinent: 'Historie' (prominent.de company history)
source.quote: Die beiden Söhne des Firmengründers übernehmen als geschäftsführende Gesellschafter die Leitung des Unternehmens.
